buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Freshness points fairly clearly to Erjavec. Workload tilts to Erjavec: 27 games in the last fortnight to Carle's 77. In the past week Carle has played 2 matches, Erjavec 0.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Carle holds a clear advantage on motivation and pressure. Deciding-set record under pressure: Carle 56%, Erjavec 40%. Recent form sits 9 pts below Carle's season win rate, against 32 pts below Erjavec's.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Carle gets a slim nod on conditions. Carle has 10 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Erjavec only 4, so the adjustment period is shorter. Both rate above their overall level on Clay, Carle by more (+34 Elo against +19 for Erjavec).

bottom_line: The model leans Erjavec at 54%; agreement across the three signals is 44/100 (mixed signals). The biggest risk is motivation & pressure: Carle is stronger in deciding sets (56% vs 40%).
